applicant.name: Mag. Petra Steiner
applicant.organisation: Danube Institute for Diabetes Research (university research group)

request.purpose: Scientific research on the epidemiology of chronic diseases to inform prevention programmes.
request.question: How many adults with type 2 diabetes are there per insurance company?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per insurance company: adults with type 2 diabetes.

note: allowed purpose, but the question cannot be interpreted from the definitions
